stem: For Lumen Analytics, CPU stays near 85 percent while memory stays under 45 percent on the app tier.
rationale: Compute-optimized families are the best starting point for sustained CPU pressure when memory is not the bottleneck. Memory-optimized families add capacity where the workload is not constrained. General-purpose can work but often pays for unnecessary balance when the bottleneck is clear. Storage-optimized families target different resource profiles and are less aligned with CPU-bound behavior.
